meta.title: C major scale, one octave, right hand ascending
meta.note: Ground truth for the fingering DP (A1). The textbook RH ascending fingering is 1-2-3-1-2-3-4-5: the thumb passes under after E4, which is the behaviour that distinguishes a real DP from a naive one-finger-per-note assignment. Quarter notes at 120 bpm = 500 ms each.
